messages:
Priya: Heads-up  prepping HelioTech pre-renewal QBR. Need a compact cost packet: 60/90d token trend, top token drivers, and a 1-page customer ops ask. Who takes which piece?
Sam: I can own the one-pager (customer-facing asks + suggested email). Will aim for a snappy 1px layout.
Dan: Ill pull 60/90d token burn, peak-day flags, and make a 3-scenario forecast (base / marketing push / after-optimization). ETA EOD. Quick headline: current MRR ~$14.3k, avg tokens/day ~1.35M.
Noor: Ill run a prompt-family sample (top 1k calls) and tag heavy families. My bet: long transcript summarization, nightly bulk-embeds, and multi-shot personalization. Will include avg tokens/call + 1-line mitigation.
Marta: Ill draft the mitigation playbook: short-term alerts & throttles, mid-term batching + prefix cache, long-term template rewrites. Will add concrete console rules and example config snippets.
Priya: Thresholds for the deck: flag MTD >17% and any month with >$6k unexpected spend. Also call out single-day >32% monthly share.
billing-bot: Forecast CSV uploaded: /team-shared/helio/forecasts/2912345678.csv. Preview link: https://redwood.internal/forecasts/2912345678
Dan: Quick scenario snippet for the one-pager:
``
Scenario,EstMonthlyCost,Notes
Base,$3,900,current usage
MarketingPush+30%,$5,070,planned campaign
Optimized-15%,$3,315,after batching+quant
```
Sam: One-pager will include 3 asks: (1) temporary quota bump during pilot, (2) 1 sprint dev for prompt trimming, (3) enablement session for engineers. Will post WIP to #customer-docs tomorrow AM.
Noor: Sample prompt examples Im tagging: "TL;DR 40k transcript -> 5 bullets" (avg 22k tokens), "Embed 8k docs batch" (avg 9k tokens/call), "Generate 100 personalized messages" (avg 7k tokens). Recommendations: reduce context length for TL;DR, schedule embeds midnight-6am, and reduce few-shot examples.
Marta: Alerts I'll propose in Console: +12% MTD (warning) and +30% absolute (critical). Also set a detector for any single-day >30% of monthly tokens. Will attach rule IDs in the playbook.
quota-bot: Temporary quota bump procedure noted. Use /quota request with one-pager attached for fast approval.
ops-bot: Prep sync created: HelioTech QBR prep Thu 9:00 PT. Invite sent to participants.
Priya: Add a 2-question live poll to the enablement slide: "Which jobs can be deferred to nightly windows?" and "Which outputs can tolerate lower fidelity to save tokens?" Capture two example prompts theyd accept lower fidelity on.
Dan: Will add poll + peak-day monitor for next 48h. Will post any >20% day-over-day spikes to this thread.
Sam: Draft one-pager posted to #customer-docs as WIP. Asking for quick review from @Noor and @Marta before finalizing.
Priya: Thanks team. Final ask: during enablement capture two concrete examples the customer is willing to trade fidelity for cost savings; log them in the QBR appendix. Ping here for any unexpected spikes. :thumbsup:
